_comment: Who gets a Telegram message right away vs. who's batched into a digest. loop-run.sh reads this: if a label isn't in `immediate`, NOTIFY_SPOOL=1 is set and the run's output goes to the spool instead. Introduced after ~20 separate messages a day became unmanageable.

_immediate_why.loop-watchdog: P0 — the watchdog itself; stays silent while things are healthy, so a message means a loop has stopped
_immediate_why.leads-watch: P0 — a new lead is money on the table; only sends on a change
_immediate_why.voice-briefing: the morning voice briefing IS the digest, for the operator
_immediate_why.backup-pull: P0 — silent on success, only speaks on a backup failure
_immediate_why.daemon-watch: P0 — the daemon watchdog: silent while services are alive; a message means one went down
_immediate_why.runtime-verify: P0 — the execution registry has drifted from reality; silent while it matches
